- [USER] User requested recommendations for cooking classes to learn authentic French dishes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended cooking schools in Paris:
  1. Cook'n With Class - specializes in traditional French dishes, classes taught in English.
  2. La Cuisine Paris - offers a wide range of classes covering different French cuisines, classes taught in English.
  3. Le Foodist - focuses on the history and culture of French cuisine, classes taught in English.
  4. Atelier des Chefs - offers classes, workshops, and cooking demonstrations, classes taught in French with English-speaking chefs available.
  5. The Parisian Kitchen - specializes in classic French dishes for small groups, classes taught in English.
